restrictions: Uniformly random 64-byte messages (two independent 256-bit words each); every evaluation is one target compression.
q = 2^127.9917 evaluations give collision probability >= 0.39 for any function (Schur-concavity of the birthday probability), so no randomness heuristic is used.
Charged per evaluation: 1 compression + 9 word operations (2 random words, 1 mask, 1 load, 1 compare, 1 branch, 3 stores) at 1/C, C = 1626.
Memory 2^134.6 bytes for the table of (digest, message) pairs; reported, not scored.
